name: ShootingScheduleStripboard
tagline: The 1st AD's stripboard on Power Platform – drag scenes into shoot days, see pages, conflicts and the Day Out of Days update live.
description: Full-app PCF control for film, TV and commercial productions: colour-coded scene strips (INT/EXT, DAY/NIGHT) in a boneyard and shoot-day blocks with page and hour totals, drag-and-drop or Move to… scheduling, cast availability, turnaround, page-target and company-move conflict checks, Day Out of Days with drop/pick-up, scene list and shoot-day overview. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Industry strip colours and eighths of a page
Boneyard and day breaks with page/hour meters
Drag-and-drop with multi-select, Move to… menu and Alt+arrow keys
Night-to-day turnaround, page target, hours and company-move warnings
Day Out of Days (SW/W/WF/H/PW/X) with CSV export
Status workflow with reasons and undo
Scene list with filters, grouping, bulk actions and CSV export
Demo mode with a fictional 12-day shoot
